note: The register of record is registry/sources.csv (licence, use, assessment). The rows here add what the doctrine kit needs for the sources that feed public products: Admiralty grade, independence group, how easily the data could be faked, expected cadence and a health probe.

adsblol-archive.descriptor: Crowd-fed ADS-B receiver archive (readsb traces with navigation-accuracy fields); daily file posted next morning.

noaa-swpc.descriptor: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center official indices and alerts.

esa-swe-scint.descriptor: ESA Space Weather Service Network ionospheric scintillation nowcast grid.

easa-gnss-firs.descriptor: EASA's table of FIRs with reported GNSS interference; official, updated irregularly.

navcen-gps-tests.descriptor: US Coast Guard Navigation Center notices of US GPS interference testing.

cygnss-l1.descriptor: NASA CYGNSS level-1 reflectometry; its noise floor is an independent sensing method for interference.
